learned_rules:
- **The money shape rates 8, or 9 if the radar shows the story still climbing and mcap is under ~$1M.** Shape: a MIGRATED coin leading on 5m volume, 25–45% off its local high, a printed higher low above the hourly low, 5m flow at or above the hourly pace, more buys than sells, top 10 under 15%, low RugCheck bundles. Both real winners looked like this (CATBOT 4.44x, FLOATER 2.19x, both under $1M) (V1, V6, V13).
- **The owner's floor is 7 under ~$1M mcap.** If the hard lines pass, flow is live (5m ≥ $10k and at or above pace), a higher low is printed and the first resistance is ≥1.5x away, rate it 7 or higher. Don't dock points for things the checklist already measured.
- **The MIGRATED buy zone is 10–60% off the local high** (owner rule). Within 10% of the high is a PASS, blocker "chasing" (46 skips: 3 ran, 35 dumped).
- **The shallow band (10–25% off the high) is a breakout trade, capped at 7.** It must be the 5m volume leader, pushing into the high right now, with flow at or above pace. Otherwise PASS, blocker "no breakout".
- **A spike counts as chasing anywhere in the zone.** If the last 5m candle is up >25% or 5m volume is >3x the hourly pace, wait for a retrace and a printed higher low. Blocker "chasing spike" (PILLSEY).
- **On MIGRATED, flow below pace or no printed higher low is a PASS, never a probe.** A printed higher low means a bounce off the hourly low, a pullback that holds above it, and price back above that bounce's high. A buy share, a fib touch or a first green candle is not one. Blockers "flow below pace" / "no higher low" (Slingoor, ANAKIN, BLUE, SI never got past 1.01x).
- **Buy close to the structure.** Enter only when price is within ~12% above the printed higher low the thesis rests on, so the thesis breaks before the hard stop. Further above it is a mid-range entry: wait for a pullback toward the level or PASS, blocker "mid-range". Stops have been filling around −35%, not −20%.
- **Rate on the first resistance (prior high, POC or 0.618).** At ≥1.5x away it can rate 8–9. At 1.3–1.5x the cap is 7. Under 1.3x is a PASS, blocker "target too close" (PAWCAT, SWAN).
- **Above ~$1M mcap, a probe (6) is the most you take,** and only if the first resistance is ≥1.5x away and a breakout with flow at or above pace is printing right now. Otherwise PASS, blocker "big cap, no room". These went 1 green in 10 (+0.7%).
- **A migration under 1h old that is still bleeding off its bond spike waits for a base above the hourly low.** Blocker "too new" (55 skips: 12 ran, 43 dumped).
- **In a vamp field, buy only the leader by 5m volume and radar mentions.** A bundle cluster inside a big same-ticker field is a PASS, blocker "split crowd" (BLUE, V1, V3).
- **A DIP needs all of these:** a 40–70% drawdown, 5m flow ≥0.7x the hourly pace, the story still on the radar, and a printed higher low with the entry within ~12% of it and the thesis invalidated under it. If all pass, size by conviction (7–8 when clean). A DIP whose catalyst already printed (news, rebrand) is a probe (6) at most until it reclaims its pullback high. A thin tech/LARP story is a PASS, blocker "dead story" (HEXN x2, SIS).
- **Hard blocks:** top 10 over 25%, dev over 1%, bundles or insiders over the line, mint or freeze authority live, LP not burned, a political figure, RugCheck danger, any hack/exploit/drain story (V6, V13, V17, owner). Name the blocker in every PASS.
- **If RugCheck didn't load, it's a probe at most (6), not a block.** That needs the dossier's top-10 and dev numbers clean, mcap under $1M and the rest in the money shape. Say bundles are unverified.
- **Manage the trade, and stops sell with no review.** If the printed higher low breaks, sell. If it hasn't reached 1.05x by minute 10 with flow under pace, exit. If it's green before initials and 5m volume drops under half the hourly pace, sell half. At the time stop, exit; the only extension is one 15-minute window while a volume surge at or above pace is printing. Every stop review so far (8 of 8) closed worse than the stop. Re-enter a stopped-out coin only once, and only when it reclaims its prior high with flow at or above pace (re-entries are 0 for 4).

rule_changes.evidence: It works as a tighter stop than the owner's code-enforced 20%, which I was told not to set. Replaced by a thesis exit (sell when the printed higher low breaks) plus the existing time-based check at minute 10 (under 1.05x with flow under pace).

rule_changes.rule: Thesis exit: sell when the printed higher low the entry rested on breaks
rule_changes.evidence: HEXN #2, SIS and AAPLCAT all broke the higher low first and then slid through the stop to -27% to -31%. This exit is set by structure, not by a percent.

rule_changes.rule: Entries above ~$1M mcap (was capped at 7; now a probe at most, and only with a breakout printing)
rule_changes.evidence: 10 trades above $1M: Something, CATBOT re-entry, FLOAT, HYPERCHAN x2, Leverhedge, PAWCAT, AAPLCAT, ANAKIN x2. Only one closed green, PAWCAT at +0.7%; the rest lost between -3% and -31%. Only FLOAT got past 1.3x, and it gave it all back. This goes below the owner's 7 floor for this band only. 10 samples with one scratch win is the strongest pattern in the book, and on a ~$74 wallet each of these was mostly fees. The floor still stands under $1M.

rule_changes.rule: Buy close to the structure: entry within ~12% above the printed higher low, otherwise PASS 'mid-range'
rule_changes.evidence: The 20% stop is set by the owner, so I fix the entry instead. The 9 stop exits filled at -59, -38, -36, -27, -31, -30, -31, -31 and -29%, about -35% on average after fees and gaps. HEXN #2, with its invalidation 13% under entry, was the smallest of them. Entering near the level lets the thesis-break exit fire before the price gaps through the hard stop.
The code fee check owns this now (target must pay 3x the round trip, round trip capped at 20% of the position), so per the owner's instruction these are no longer learned rules.
